answer: Mail each operator a paper postcard with a one-time code to a real street address, and allow one agent per verified household. An atlas of address data flags PO boxes, mail drops, and hundreds of cards headed to one lone building on a mesa outside town. Every clone needs its own physical mailbox at about $15 a month, so a 1,000-agent farm pays roughly $15,000 monthly just to keep its foothold on that ledge, and addresses are re-checked yearly.
